question: The Union Finance Ministry issued a notification amending the Electoral Bonds Scheme to allow the sale of electoral bonds for extra ______ days in the year of general elections to the Legislative Assembly of States and UTs with legislature.
solution:
The correct answer is __**15.**____**​**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Electoral Bonds Scheme** is a way for **individuals, companies, and organizations** to donate money to political parties in India.
 
• The amendment to the scheme allows for the **sale of electoral bonds** for an additional **15 days** during general elections to the** Legislative Assembly** of States and UTs with legislature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Electoral Bonds Scheme **was introduced in** 2018** and has been controversial since its inception.
 
• The scheme allows for **anonymity in donations, **which has led to criticism that it promotes **corruption and illegal funding** of political parties. 
 
• The scheme has also been criticized for **favoring the ruling party**, as it allows for the sale of **electoral bonds** only through select branches of certain banks, which are believed to be more accessible to the** ruling party's supporters.**
 
• The amendment to the scheme allowing for the** sale of electoral bonds** for an additional **15 days** during general elections has been criticized as a way to further benefit the ruling party, as they have more resources to purchase these bonds during elections.
